entries.title: Web addresses in a card's thread open with a click or a tap
entries.body: A web address written in a card's thread, in your replies or the crew's, is now a link on your computer and on your iPhone and iPad. Click it, tap it or press Enter on it to open it in your browser.

picture.alt: A card's thread whose answer from the first mate shows a sign-in page's address underlined as a link
